name: label
useFor: Use above every field, tied to it with htmlFor (or aria-labelledby for a Select or Combobox). Keep labels short nouns (Parcel size, Location). Beside a checkbox, radio or switch, prefer the control's own children as its label.
title: Label
description: A field's label: 12px regular in 80% Forest, 8px above its field. Beside a checkbox, radio or switch it becomes the control's own 13px Forest label. A required mark inside it is brick.
